secondArticle.title: How to ensure the safest home exchange (Safety Guidelines)
secondArticle.description:
Your vacation should be **as safe as possible**, so you can truly enjoy it, relax, and have fun. In this article, you’ll find the essential guidelines to ensure the safest home exchange experience.

Some of our users complete **10, 20, or even 50 exchanges per year** — but we understand that the very first time you consider leaving your home to someone else can feel overwhelming. That’s why we’re here: to provide you with all the information you need to feel completely secure.

## The foundation of our system: User verification

Users with fully verified profiles receive the **Verified** badge and are easily recognizable across the platform.

In addition:
- Every user and every property has public reviews
- Reviews add an extra layer of transparency and trust

After reaching a certain number of successful exchanges and positive reviews, users earn special badges such as **Golden Host** and **Golden Guest**, indicating experience and reliability.

## Practical safety guidelines

To maximize safety, we recommend:
- Taking photos of your home **before and after** the exchange
- Avoiding leaving valuable items in your home while you’re away
- Always communicating through the platform chat, so everything is written and recorded
- If you meet in person or via video call, writing a recap afterwards for clarity
- Defining the house rules in advance and keeping them in written form (for a complete exchange etiquette guide, read [here](/articles/3))
- Reporting users with suspicious or misleading behavior, such as:
  - Requesting money for an exchange
  - Being threatening
  - Being unclear about important matters

> We actively investigate such cases. Users considered a risk to the community are permanently banned from the platform.

## Additional protection through insurance

For extra peace of mind, we collaborate with insurance companies to offer **optional coverage packages**.

These packages can cover:
- Property damage
- Theft
- Other unexpected incidents

Insurance coverage is optional and comes at an additional cost, but it’s available for those who want to feel 100% protected.

Have a great Vacanza!

thirdArticle.title: The 4 types of exchange
thirdArticle.description:
Discover all the types of exchange available in Vacanza and choose the one you prefer.
You can also choose multiple ones, depending on your needs at the moment.

### 1. Simultaneous exchange
This is the classic and most common type of exchange.

I come to your house in **Crete**, and you come to my house in **Athens**.

We both enjoy our stay, make new friends, gain new experiences, and return home full of joy and satisfaction — with some extra euros saved.
We also keep in touch, in case one of us wants to return to the same destination in the future.

### 2. Non-simultaneous exchange
With this type of exchange, stays do **not** happen at the same time.

You can come to **Athens** now (for example, while I am on a business trip), and I will come to **Crete** at a later time, when your house becomes available.

### 3. Co-living
In a co-living exchange, you can stay in my house while I am also living there.

For example, you may have an exam tomorrow and need a spare room, while I am busy working.
Don’t worry — we both follow our daily routines, and if we want, we can also spend some time together.

### 4. Non-reciprocal exchange
In this case, only one person stays at the partner’s house, without offering their own home in return.

This is not a traditional exchange, but we mention it for flexibility and additional possibilities.

> This type can be very useful for **pet-sitting**.
> A pet sitter can stay in your home free of charge, take care of your pets, and enjoy accommodation at no cost for the agreed period.

Feel free to communicate openly with your exchange partner and choose the type that suits you both best.

Join Vacanza today!

fourthArticle.title: How to create attractive listings (Members only)
fourthArticle.description:
To increase your chances of successful exchanges, it’s essential to build trust with people who view your profile and properties.

Start by completing your profile verification until it reaches **100%**.

For your properties, follow the best practices below to attract more requests.

## Guidelines for attractive listings

- **High-quality photos**
  Use clear, well-lit photos that show each space in a functional and aesthetic way. A tidy home helps others imagine themselves there.

- **Complete and honest description**
  Include amenities, house rules, and any important details. Transparency builds trust and avoids misunderstandings.

- **Highlight what makes your home special**
  Showcase unique elements such as views, balconies, style, or atmosphere.

- **Emphasize the location**
  Mention positive aspects of the area and how well it’s connected to key points like airports, ports, public transport, sea, mountains, or attractions. Travel time is a big plus.

- **Nearby services**
  Share distances to supermarkets, pharmacies, banks, and other essential services.

- **Describe the neighborhood**
  Is it quiet, central, or family-friendly? A short, honest overview helps a lot.

- **Local activities & experiences**
  Highlight activities such as hiking, surfing, sailing, skiing, cultural events, or local food spots.

- **Pets & children**
  Be clear about whether your home is suitable for pets or families.

- **Avoid hiding important details**
  Honest listings prevent frustration, bad reviews, and unsuccessful exchanges.

Good listings work best with good communication.
Always be friendly, polite, and clear when chatting with other members.

**Have a great Vacanza experience:**

fifthArticle.title: Etiquette (Members only)
fifthArticle.description:
Home exchanging is enjoyable and cost-free, but it requires mutual respect and clear rules agreed in advance.

We encourage all members to be polite, considerate, and respectful of each other’s needs to ensure a great experience for everyone.

Requesting money for an exchange is strictly prohibited. If this happens, please report it to us.

## Good etiquette guidelines

- **Friendly behavior and respect**
  Always communicate with politeness, empathy, and openness.

- **Be honest about your property**
  Clearly describe the location, amenities, and any special conditions.

- **Personalize your communication**
  Avoid copy-paste messages and take the time to communicate personally.

- **Remove personal belongings**
  Store personal items and family photos so guests feel welcomed and comfortable.

- **Clarify what to bring**
  Agree in advance on linens, towels, kitchen items, or anything else needed.

- **Write down essentials**
  Share Wi-Fi passwords, appliance instructions, and house rules clearly.

- **Agree on key exchange**
  Decide whether keys will be left inside, with a trusted person, via lockbox, or exchanged in person.

- **Optional car exchange**
  If both sides agree, exchanging cars can help avoid rental costs.

- **Set clear rules without pressure**
  Agree on guidelines before the stay, then let everyone enjoy their time.

- **Be available for local tips**
  Suggest places to eat, visit, and enjoy the local culture.

- **Report issues immediately**
  If something breaks, communicate right away and decide on a solution together. Optional insurance is always available.

- **Handle cancellations responsibly**
  If a serious issue arises, notify your partner in time or help find alternative accommodation.

- **Leave the house spotless**
  Treat the home as if it were your own. Professional cleaning is optional with host approval.

- **Small gestures matter**
  A thank-you gift is always appreciated, if you wish.

- **Stay in touch**
  Many exchanges turn into long-term friendships and future stays.

By following these simple guidelines, you help ensure a pleasant and safe experience for everyone.

For maximum safety, we also encourage you to read our [Safety Guidelines](/articles/2).

**Enjoy Vacanza:**

tenthArticle.title: Discover the World Differently: How Retirees Travel with Vacanza
tenthArticle.description:
Retirement is the time to finally live life at your own pace. To explore, to connect, and to enjoy new experiences without work schedules or deadlines. Yet travel can often be expensive, and traditional accommodations tend to consume a large part of any budget. That’s why more and more retirees are choosing home exchange — and why Vacanza makes it easier, safer, and more rewarding than ever.

Travel Without the Price Tag
With Vacanza, you can explore every corner of Greece without paying for hotels or rentals. Instead, you exchange homes with other members for a specific period.
Imagine spending a week in a charming home in Nafplio, a month by the sea in Crete, or enjoying quiet days in a traditional stone village in Epirus — while your own home hosts another traveler eager to discover your area.

For retirees, comfort truly matters. Vacanza offers all the advantages of a real home: a kitchen to cook at your leisure, outdoor spaces to relax, and the warmth of a neighborhood that feels familiar from day one.
Vacanza is built around a trusted, community-driven environment. Every member is verified, with profiles, photos, reviews, and direct communication, so you always know who you are exchanging with. Many retirees discover that the greatest rewards are not only the destinations, but also the friendships created along the way.

One Annual Membership. Unlimited Possibilities
Unlike pay-per-stay platforms, Vacanza works with a simple annual subscription. One membership gives you access to unlimited exchanges throughout the year — from short weekend getaways to long, relaxing stays — without extra booking fees.
For retirees who enjoy traveling often or escaping seasonally, it offers outstanding value.

Vacanza is not just about saving money. It’s about traveling like a local, rediscovering Greece from the inside, and experiencing genuine hospitality. You’ll stay in authentic Greek homes, shop at local markets, and connect with people who share your love for meaningful travel.
Whether you live in Athens, Thessaloniki, or a small island village, Vacanza opens the door to a richer, safer, and more personal way to explore Greece.

Join the community of travelers who have discovered the freedom of home exchange.
With Vacanza, your home becomes your ticket to unforgettable journeys.

Join Vacanza today — one annual subscription, endless adventures.

eleventhArticle.title: Why Vacanza Is the Future of Sustainable Travel
eleventhArticle.description:
Today more than ever, traveling sustainably — with respect for the environment and local communities — truly matters. Vacanza offers a new way of traveling that is eco-friendly, community-driven, and fair for everyone involved.

Vacanza naturally supports eco-conscious travel habits. It significantly reduces resource consumption and carbon footprint compared to hotels and large hospitality structures, which often require high energy use and constant turnover.

At the same time, Vacanza places strong emphasis on small local communities. It promotes slow travel and deeper cultural experiences, allowing you to discover Greece in an authentic and meaningful way.
You may have noticed that properties on traditional booking platforms often look uniform, following the same trends and aesthetics, disconnected from local culture. With Vacanza, there’s no need to appeal to a specific market or apply revenue-maximizing strategies — the focus is simply exchange, connection, and experience.

Most importantly, Vacanza is a non-speculative model of travel. Unlike short-term rentals such as Airbnb, it does not put pressure on the housing market or contribute to rising property prices in city centers. In recent years, short-term rentals have led to sharp housing inflation, even resulting in restrictions in places like the historic center of Athens.

In conclusion, Vacanza not only provides a more sustainable and eco-friendly way to travel, but also supports long-term housing availability for local residents, helping preserve communities and slow down price increases.

Ready to join the future of travel?

fourteenthArticle.title: Make New Friends with Vacanza
fourteenthArticle.description:
While traveling or working, you can make friends in different places and create genuine new connections.

Sometimes, being in a foreign place where you don’t know any locals can feel isolating. **That’s exactly where Vacanza comes in.**

Because beyond travel and savings, there is a deeper reward that many people don’t expect until they experience it themselves:

**Real friendships and human connections** that naturally grow from sharing homes, stories, and everyday life — even for a short time.

## The Greek Spirit of *Filoxenia*

In Greece, hospitality isn’t just politeness — **it’s a way of life**.
The ancient concept of *filoxenia* literally means *“friend to a stranger”*, and it remains deeply rooted in Greek culture today.

When you exchange homes in Greece, you’re not just borrowing a space. **You’re stepping into a story, a neighborhood, and often a local community.**

Whether you’re staying in:
- Athens
- A seaside village in the Peloponnese
- Or a tucked-away island like Naxos

you enter a world where connections matter.

You might be welcomed with fresh fruit from a neighbor’s garden, receive insider tips on the best local taverna, or discover a hidden beach. Many exchanges turn into friendships that last long after the trip ends.

## Home Exchange: A Natural Bridge Between People

Unlike hotels or short-term rentals, home exchanges are built on **trust, communication, and mutual respect** from the very beginning.

It starts with:
- Messaging
- Sharing personal details
- Sometimes even a video call

You’re not booking a place — **you’re building a relationship.**

These bonds often grow beyond the first exchange:
- Families stay in touch and organize future swaps
- Guests become pen pals, sharing recipes or photos
- Hosts introduce visitors to friends and relatives
- Some even meet in person to hand over the keys

A simple exchange can become **a global friendship network** — a modern expression of an ancient Greek value.

## The Real Perks of Human Connection

Travel shows you places. **People give those places meaning.**

When friendships grow through home exchange, the benefits go far beyond accommodation:
- **Authentic travel** — local experiences beyond tourist routes
- **Cultural learning** — conversations teach more than any guidebook
- **A sense of belonging** — shared meals, celebrations, and moments
- **Travel support** — from ferry tips to borrowing beach gear

## A Travel Community — Not Just a Platform

At its best, home exchange is not a booking service — **it’s a community**.
A space where trust, warmth, and meaningful travel thrive.

If you’re considering a home exchange in Greece, go in with an open heart.

The most valuable thing you might bring back isn’t a souvenir — **it’s a friendship that crosses borders.**

Ready to travel in a more personal, authentic, and human way?
